name: Concentric Tube Jig
subtitle: 3/4 in to 1 1/4 in stepped sizing gauge
description: A clean coaxial woodworking sizing jig with nine quarter-inch-high tube steps from 3/4 in through 1 1/4 in.

dimensionTargets: Nine outside-diameter tube steps from 19.05 mm (3/4 in) to 31.75 mm (1 1/4 in).
Adjacent tube diameters differ by 1.5875 mm (1/16 in).
Each tube step is 6.35 mm (1/4 in) high.
The common 12.7 mm (1/2 in) bore runs through the full stepped stack.
invariants: Keep every tube step coaxial with the shared through-bore.
Build the default range inclusively from 3/4 in through 1 1/4 in.
Keep the 1/16 in default diameter increment across every adjacent pair.
Keep each default tube step at 1/4 in height.
Preserve a printable radial wall of at least the configured minimum.
Place the largest tube step on the build plate so every successive step narrows upward without supports.

scripts.name: audit
scripts.description: Validates the stepped tube range, wall thickness, and printable STL topology.
